name: Smith Machine Squat
summary: A guided back squat performed on a Smith machine to target the quadriceps and glutes with reduced balance demands.

setup: Set the Smith machine bar at approximately mid-chest to collarbone height.
Step under the bar, placing it securely across your upper trapezius muscles.
Grip the bar firmly outside shoulder width and place your feet about shoulder-width apart, positioned a few inches forward of the bar path.
Rotate the bar to unhook it from the safety catches and stand tall with a braced core.
steps: Inhale, brace your abdomen, and begin descending by breaking at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Lower smoothly along the fixed track until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your midfoot and heel, extending your knees and hips to return to the standing starting position.
Exhale near the top of the movement without forcefully locking out your knees.
instructions.breathing: Inhale and brace your core prior to descending, and exhale as you press back up to the top.

common_faults.fault: Placing the feet directly beneath the bar path, which can cause excessive forward knee travel and heel rise.
common_faults.correction: Step your feet several inches forward so your shins stay closer to vertical and your weight stays balanced over the whole foot.

common_faults.fault: Relying on the bar track to slouch or lose torso tension, rounding the spine.
common_faults.correction: Maintain active core bracing and an upright chest throughout the entire range of motion.

precautions: Always adjust the Smith machine mechanical safety stoppers just below your bottom squat depth before loading weight.
